valid.title: Join {workspace}
valid.body: You have been invited to join {workspace} as {role}.

expired.title: This invitation has expired
expired.body: Invitations last 7 days. Ask the person who invited you to send a new one.

revoked.title: This invitation was withdrawn
revoked.body: The workspace withdrew this invitation. Ask the person who invited you if you still need access.

used.title: This invitation has already been used
used.body: Each invitation link works once. If it was you, the workspace is already in your switcher.

invalid.title: This invitation link is not valid
invalid.body: Check that you opened the full link from the email, or ask for a new invitation.

emailMismatch.title: This invitation is for a different email
emailMismatch.body: You are signed in as {email}, but this invitation was sent to another address. Sign in with the invited email to accept it.

seatLimit.title: No seats left in this workspace
seatLimit.body: The workspace's plan has no free seat for you. Ask the person who invited you to add a seat.

invite.differentAccount: Sign in with a different account

errors.offline: You are offline. Connect to accept the invitation.
errors.signedOut: Your session ended. Sign in again to continue.
errors.generic: Could not accept the invitation. Please try again.

members.title: Members
members.description: People in {workspace} and what they can do.

readOnly.viewer: You can view members but not change them.
readOnly.member: Only owners can change roles or remove members.

members.empty: It is just you for now. Invite juniors, clerks or co-counsel when you are ready.

roleDescriptions.owner: Everything, including billing, members and deleting the workspace.
roleDescriptions.advocate: Full practice access. Can invite juniors, clerks and viewers.
roleDescriptions.junior: Works on assigned matters and shared chamber matters.
roleDescriptions.clerk: Listings, tasks and documents. No strategy notes or matter memory.
roleDescriptions.viewer: Can read, but not change anything.

rolesPanel.title: Roles
rolesPanel.description: What each person can see and do in this workspace.
rolesPanel.clerkNote: Clerks never see strategy notes or matter memory, even on matters they work on.

invite.title: Invite members
invite.description: They get an email with a link to join {workspace}. The link works for 7 days.
invite.emailsHint: Paste several addresses at once. Separate them with commas or spaces.
invite.invalidChip: {email} is not a valid email address
invite.noteHint: A short line for the people you invite.

errors.emailsRequired: Add at least one email address.
errors.invalidEmails: Fix or remove the addresses marked as not valid.
errors.tooMany: Invite at most {max} people at a time.
errors.forbidden: You cannot invite {email} with this role.
errors.rateLimited: Too many invitations for now. Try {email} again later.
errors.invalid: {email} could not be invited. Check the address.
errors.conflict: {email} could not be invited: the workspace has no seat left for this role.
errors.failed: Could not invite {email}. Please try again.

seatLimit.message: Your plan includes {seats} seats. Add a seat to invite more people.

changeRole.title: Change role
changeRole.label: Role for {name}
changeRole.ownerHint: Making someone the owner is an ownership transfer. You confirm it on the next step.

transfer.title: Transfer ownership to {name}?

consequences.newOwner: {name} gets billing, member management and workspace deletion.
consequences.you: You become an advocate and keep full practice access.
consequences.undo: Only the new owner can transfer ownership back.

transfer.confirmMismatch: Type the workspace address exactly as shown.

remove.title: Remove {name} from {workspace}?
remove.sessions: Their sessions in this workspace end.
remove.otherWorkspaces: Their other workspaces are not affected.
remove.openWork: {count, plural, one {# open task or obligation moves} other {# open tasks and obligations move}} to the member you choose.
remove.checking: Checking for open tasks and obligations
remove.reassignRequired: Choose who takes over the open work.

errors.lastOwner: A workspace always needs an owner. Transfer ownership first.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to do this.
errors.notFound: This member or invitation is no longer here. Reload to see the latest list.
errors.validation: Some details need attention. Check and try again.
errors.signedOut: Your session ended. Sign in again to continue.
errors.offline: You are offline. Connect to make changes.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

seats.title: Seats
seats.note: Invitations take a seat when they are accepted.

transferPicker.title: Transfer ownership
transferPicker.description: Choose the member who will become the owner of {workspace}.
transferPicker.label: New owner
transferPicker.none: Invite another member before you transfer ownership.
